body: Insert: own-line layout when the last item ends its line (even with a // comment) - new item on its own line after it, comma added right after the last value; inline otherwise - after every comment following the last item, ', ' joined; empty container - on a new line after the opening bracket's line (and any comment running from it), else just before the closing bracket. Delete mirrors each case (whole lines with attached comments; the predecessor's comma when the deleted item was last without one). Found and fixed by FuzzSetDelete/FuzzEditSequence; their crashers stay in jsonc/testdata/fuzz as regression seeds. Disable/Restore is for object members only; Restore matches the decoded key and takes a comma on its own line with the member.
title: jsonc layout rules make Set then Delete an exact inverse
